fix: Every `SharedAppDataStore::get_value` / `SharedAppData::get_value` call from a build converts its `&str` key into a fresh `Rc<str>` (`key.into()` at line 69), allocating on each read even when the key already exists. Look up by borrowed key first and allocate only on the insert miss: implement `Borrow<str> for SharedAppDataKey` (derived Hash/Eq on the Rc<str> newtype match str's), take `key: impl AsRef<str> + Into<SharedAppDataKey>` in get_value, do `if let Some(e) = entries.get_mut(key.as_ref())` for the hit path, and build the owned key only inside the `or_insert` miss branch. Alternatively intern keys as `&'static str` where callers use literals.

`HashSet::from([aspect])` allocates a HashSet for every registered aspect on each notifying model update, forced by the trait signature at line 179 (`aspects: &HashSet<Self::Aspect>`). Change the trait method to take one aspect, e.g. `fn update_should_notify_dependent(&self, old: &Self, aspect: &Self::Aspect) -> bool;`, which is equivalent here because the loop asks about one aspect at a time; call it as `model.update_should_notify_dependent(&old, &aspect)`. Multi-aspect dependents are already handled by the per-aspect loop. Keep the doc comment at line 176-178 in step.
